detailed_descriptions.en: During a tea party, Alice and her friends become trapped in a world created by demons. Will they be able to escape this twisted realm safely? This game is an escape adventure . Players control Alice and her companions, searching for an exit within rooms filled with traps and mechanisms. By clicking around the environment, you can find items and hints, solve various puzzles, and advance to the next stage. Escape Game Includes puzzle elements

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
During a tea party, Alice and her friends become trapped in a world created by demons.

Will they be able to escape this twisted realm safely?

This game is an escape adventure.

Players control Alice and her companions, searching for an exit within rooms filled with traps and mechanisms.
By clicking around the environment, you can find items and hints, solve various puzzles, and advance to the next stage.

  • Escape Game

  • Includes puzzle elements
